q: It is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he will be saved out of it.

s: Jacob is called servant of the LORD (addressed as my servant)
q: O Jacob my servant, says the LORD.

s: Jacob will live quiet and at ease (after return, unafraid)
q: Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid.

s: wound (Israel's incurable wound) has property incurable
q: “Your hurt is incurable. Your wound is grievous.

s: the LORD commands Jeremiah (to write his words in a book)
q: ‘Write all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.

s: wound (Israel's incurable wound) has cause iniquity (Israel's sin)
q: For the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins have increased, I have done these things to you.

s: iniquity (Israel's sin) has property great (sins have increased)
q: for the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins were increased.

s: enemies and oppressors (of Israel) will become plunder and prey (reversal of their fortunes)
q: Those who plunder you will be plunder. I will make all who prey on you become prey.

s: restoration (of Israel) includes rebuilt city and palace (on its own hill)
q: The city will be built on its own hill, and the palace will be inhabited in its own place.

s: restoration (of Israel) includes multiplied and glorified people
q: I will multiply them, and they will not be few; I will also glorify them, and they will not be small.

s: restoration (of Israel) includes prince from among them
q: Their prince will be one of them, and their ruler will proceed from among them.

s: Israel has lovers who lovers (of Israel) (have forgotten and do not seek her)
q: All your lovers have forgotten you. They don’t seek you.

s: Israel is called Zion (called an outcast by enemies)
q: saying, ‘It is Zion, whom no man seeks after.’”

s: the LORD promises to reverse restoration of Israel (return from exile) (future promise)
q: I will reverse the captivity of my people Israel and Judah,’ says the LORD.

s: the LORD promises to return people to land (given to Israel's fathers) (future promise)
q: I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they will possess it.

s: the LORD gave land to fathers (Israel's fathers)
q: the land that I gave to their fathers

s: the LORD will raise up David (the future king) (as king for the people)
q: they will serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them.

s: the LORD is with Israel (to save)
q: For I am with you, says the LORD, to save you;

s: the LORD corrects Israel (in measure, without leaving unpunished)
q: but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.

s: the LORD caused wound (Israel's incurable wound) (because of Israel's iniquity)
q: For I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins were increased.

s: the LORD loves Israel (with an everlasting love)
q: Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love.

s: new covenant is made with Israel (house of Israel)
q: I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah,

s: new covenant is made with Judah (house of Judah)
q: I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah,

s: new covenant has content law written on the heart
q: I will put my law in their inward parts, and I will write it in their heart.

s: new covenant includes forgiveness of iniquity
q: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.

s: new covenant differs from covenant made when leaving Egypt (which their fathers broke)
q: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt, which covenant of mine they broke

s: restoration of Israel (return from exile) involves gathering from north country (and the uttermost parts of the earth)
q: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the uttermost parts of the earth

s: restoration of Israel (return from exile) has feature turning mourning into joy
q: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.

s: the LORD is father of Israel
q: for I am a father to Israel. Ephraim is my firstborn.

s: the LORD is father of Ephraim (firstborn)
q: Ephraim is my firstborn.

s: the LORD is a God of Israel (LORD of Armies)
q: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says:

s: the LORD gives sun, moon, and stars (as lights by day and night)
q: who gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night

s: the LORD has name LORD of Armies
q: the LORD of Armies is his name

s: the LORD ransomed Israel (as Jacob, from a stronger hand)
q: For the LORD has ransomed Jacob, and redeemed him from the hand of him who was stronger than he.

s: Israel is people of the LORD
q: I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.

s: Jeremiah is a prophet
q: Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the guard

s: Baruch the son of Neriah holds deed of purchase (commanded to store it in an earthen vessel)
q: I delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah

s: field at Anathoth is located in Benjamin
q: my field that is in Anathoth, which is in the land of Benjamin

s: field at Anathoth has price seventeen shekels of silver
q: weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver

s: field at Anathoth is owned by Jeremiah (bought by right of redemption)
q: I bought the field that was in Anathoth of Hanamel my uncle’s son

s: deed of purchase has part sealed deed and open deed (two copies)
q: both that which was sealed, containing the terms and conditions, and that which was open

s: deed of purchase is stored in earthen vessel (so it lasts many days)
q: put them in an earthen vessel, that they may last many days.

s: Jerusalem is given into hand of Chaldeans (declared by the LORD)
q: I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will take it.

s: Jerusalem has disposition provocation to the LORD (since it was built)
q: For this city has been to me a provocation of my anger and of my wrath from the day that they built it even to this day

s: Chaldeans is besieging Jerusalem (under the king of Babylon)
q: the king of Babylon’s army was besieging Jerusalem

s: Israel has disposition evil from youth (with Judah)
q: the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done only that which was evil in my sight from their youth

s: Jeremiah is confined in court of the guard (imprisoned by Zedekiah)
q: Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the guard, which was in the king of Judah’s house.

s: people of Judah practices idolatry and child sacrifice (high places of Baal in the valley of the son of Hinnom)
q: They built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through fire to Molech

s: the LORD is a God of Israel (also LORD of Armies, God of all flesh)
q: the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel

s: the LORD has attribute nothing too hard
q: There is nothing too hard for you.

s: the LORD made heavens and earth (by great power)
q: you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm

s: restoration of the captivity promises return of exiles (LORD will gather and resettle them)
q: I will gather them out of all the countries where I have driven them in my anger, and in my wrath, and in great indignation; and I will bring them again to this place.

s: restoration of the captivity promises everlasting covenant (LORD will not turn from doing them good)
q: I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good.

s: restoration of the captivity promises land purchases resume (fields bought across Judah)
q: Men will buy fields for money, sign the deeds, seal them, and call witnesses

s: siege of Jerusalem occurs in tenth year of Zedekiah (eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar)
q: in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar

s: Zedekiah is a king of Judah
q: Zedekiah king of Judah

s: Zedekiah imprisons Jeremiah (for prophesying Babylon's conquest)
q: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, “Why do you prophesy

s: Nebuchadnezzar is a king of Babylon
q: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon

s: Hanamel is a uncle's son of Jeremiah (cousin)
q: Hanamel my uncle’s son
